response.sql: WITH rc AS (SELECT f.rating AS rating, COUNT(*) AS rentals FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rentals) AS avg_rentals FROM rc) SELECT AVG(rc.rentals) AS avg_rentals_above_avg_ratings, AVG(rc.rentals - overall.avg_rentals) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM rc CROSS JOIN overall WHERE rc.rentals > overall.avg_rentals
